name: nbnext
description: NB Next application with client and server

scripts.i: npm run setup-env && npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && npm run setup-hooks
scripts.setup-env: cd client && npm run setup-env && cd ../server && npm run setup-env
scripts.setup-env:check: cd client && npm run setup-env:check && cd ../server && npm run check-env
scripts.setup-env:validate: cd client && npm run validate-env && cd ../server && npm run validate-env
